# Extract the numeric part from the 'home team score' column
# The scores are in format like "14.7 (91)", we need the number before the parentheses
df['home_score_numeric'] = df['home team score'].str.extract(r'(\d+)\.\d+\s*\(\d+\)').astype(int)

# Calculate the average of all home team scores
average_home_score = df['home_score_numeric'].mean()

# Check if the average is less than 12
answer = average_home_score < 12
